note: PROVISIONAL held-out set (plan §3.4). Never used in practice; separate structures and stories; three parallel forms A/B/C.

structures.notes: Together-preferring, different favourites; both ways of ending up apart are equally bad (ordinally distinct from every practice structure).
Replaces h.s.m3b (isomorphic to m3.s.one). Only A has a strictly better action; B wants to differ from A, with no ties.
No strictly better action for either side (answer “no” for the held-out dominance form C).
Elimination starts with the learner’s a2, then b2, a1, b3; leaves (a3, b1). Rows/columns relabelled in the distribution audit so the answers are not a2/(a2,b3).
Weak dominance for the learner on a1 (tie at b1); the other side’s better choice depends on yours.
Held-out best-response-tie structure for M2 (seat B has three actions; a genuine tie against a2). Not isomorphic to m2.s.three or any practised M2 structure (engine-checked).

Held-out social-dilemma structure for M3, parallel to m3.s.rush (i.m3.dilemma): a3 strictly dominant for A, b1 for B; their outcome (5, 4) is worse for both than (a2, b2) at (7, 5). Engine-checked not isomorphic to m3.s.rush, m3.s.pledge, m3.s.roommate or any other M3 structure under action relabelling or seat swap.

Second held-out both-dominant 2x2 structure for M3 (form B of h.m3.dom), structurally distinct from h.s.m3a: different payoff pattern and a different engine family (o, not h). Engine-checked not isomorphic to h.s.m3a or any other M3 structure under action relabelling or seat swap.

skins.title: Sunday badminton
skins.situation: You and Mira each book a badminton court for Sunday, the indoor court or the outdoor one. Mr Rane, the club manager, takes bookings from anyone.

incentives.h.s.m1a: You like the indoor court more; Mira likes the outdoor one more. Each of you would rather play together than alone.

skins.timing: You book at the same time. Neither sees the other’s booking.
skins.information: You know which court Mira likes. You don’t know which one she will book.
skins.matrixLabel: Outcomes for your court and Mira’s court

skins.title: Presenting the plan
skins.situation: You and Ajay each sign up to present the team plan, before the break or after it. Ms Dutta, who chairs the session, keeps both slots open.

incentives.h.s.m1a: You would rather present before the break; Ajay would rather present after it. Both of you want to present together rather than separately.

skins.timing: You sign up at the same time. Neither sees the other’s slot.
skins.information: You know what Ajay wants. You don’t know which slot he will take.
skins.matrixLabel: Outcomes for your slot and Ajay’s slot

skins.title: A weekend game
skins.situation: You and your friend Tanvi each pick a game for the weekend: chess at the club or cards at home.

incentives.h.s.m1a: You enjoy chess more; Tanvi enjoys cards more. Each of you would rather play together than alone, so how your weekend goes depends on Tanvi’s pick too.

skins.timing: You both pick on Friday, separately.
skins.information: You know what Tanvi enjoys. You don’t know what she will pick.
skins.matrixLabel: Outcomes for your game and Tanvi’s game

skins.title: The shop sign
skins.situation: You put up a sign first, offering free delivery or not. Mr Arora, who runs the shop next door, sees your sign and then decides whether to match it.

incentives.h.s.m1b: Free delivery brings you extra orders, but Mr Arora matching it would take away more than it brings. Matching earns Mr Arora customers, and he gains a little more when you offer delivery too.

skins.timing: You decide first. Mr Arora decides after seeing your sign.
skins.information: Mr Arora sees your sign before choosing. You know how he runs his shop.
skins.matrixLabel: Outcomes for your sign and Mr Arora’s reply

skins.title: Film night
skins.situation: You choose first which film to put on, a comedy or a drama. Your sister Diya sees your pick and then decides whether to watch with you or read instead.

incentives.h.s.m1b: How the evening goes for each of you depends on the film and on Diya’s reply.

skins.timing: You choose first. Diya chooses after seeing the film.
skins.information: Diya sees your pick before choosing. You know her tastes.
skins.matrixLabel: Outcomes for your film and Diya’s reply

skins.title: Light and dark squares
skins.situation: You place a counter first, on a light square or a dark square. The other side sees where it is, then places theirs on a light or a dark square.

incentives.h.s.m1b: What each side gets depends on where both counters end up.

skins.timing: You place first. The other side places after seeing yours.
skins.information: The other side sees your counter before choosing. Each side knows the rules.
skins.matrixLabel: Outcomes for your square and the other side’s square

skins.title: Market day
skins.situation: You and Salim, two wholesalers, each pick which day to bring goods to the weekly market: Tuesday or Friday.

incentives.h.s.m2a: Most buyers come on the day both of you are there, and a shared Friday draws more of them than a shared Tuesday. A wholesaler on his own still gets a few buyers on a Friday, but hardly any on a Tuesday.

skins.timing: You both decide at the start of the week, separately.
skins.information: You both know what the other wants. You don’t know Salim’s day.
skins.matrixLabel: Outcomes for your day and Salim’s day

skins.title: The residents’ meeting
skins.situation: You and Rekha are organising a residents’ meeting. Each of you sends out a notice with a time, afternoon or evening, without checking with the other.

incentives.h.s.m2a: Matching notices fill the room, and a shared evening suits you both better than a shared afternoon. If the notices differ, a few residents still come in the evening, hardly anyone in the afternoon.

skins.timing: You both send your notice on the same day.
skins.information: You both know what the other wants. You don’t know which time Rekha will send.
skins.matrixLabel: Outcomes for your time and Rekha’s time

skins.title: Two buttons
skins.situation: You and the other side each press one of two buttons, round or flat, at the same moment.

incentives.h.s.m2a: Matching buttons pay you both, and two flat buttons pay more than two round ones. If the buttons differ, whoever pressed flat still gets a little and whoever pressed round gets nothing.

skins.timing: You both press at the same moment.
skins.information: Each side knows what the other wants. You don’t know which button will be pressed.
skins.matrixLabel: Outcomes for your button and the other side’s button

skins.title: Mode and switch
skins.situation: A device has two modes you can set, and an environment switch the other side controls. You set your mode; at the same moment, the other side sets the switch.

incentives.h.s.m2b: Mode one scores well when the switch is up and not at all when it’s down; mode two helps a little either way, more when the switch is down.

skins.timing: You both set yours at the same moment, separately.
skins.information: You know how the other side’s scoring works. You don’t know which way it will set the switch.
skins.matrixLabel: Outcomes for your mode and the switch

skins.title: Stock for market day
skins.situation: You run a market stall and stock either umbrellas or sunhats for the week. Irfan, who sets the market’s weekly feature, decides separately whether the feature is rain gear or sun gear.

incentives.h.s.m2b: Umbrellas sell well when the feature is rain gear and not at all when it’s sun gear; sunhats sell a little either way, a bit more when the feature is sun gear.

skins.timing: You both decide before the market opens, separately.
skins.information: You know how shoppers respond to the feature. You don’t know which feature Irfan will set.
skins.matrixLabel: Outcomes for your stock and the market feature

skins.title: The community stall
skins.situation: You are preparing a stall for the neighbourhood festival, either a craft display or a food display. Preeti, who sets the festival’s theme, decides separately between handicrafts and local food.

incentives.h.s.m2b: The craft display draws a crowd when the theme is handicrafts and barely any when it’s local food; the food display does alright either way, a bit better when the theme is local food.

skins.timing: You both decide this week, separately.
skins.information: You know how fairgoers respond. You don’t know which theme Preeti will set.
skins.matrixLabel: Outcomes for your display and the festival’s theme

skins.title: The grant report
skins.situation: You and Bina are each writing half of a grant report. Each of you decides whether to follow the shared template or use your own layout.

incentives.h.s.m3a: The template saves you a day of formatting, and the report reads best when both halves follow it. If only one half uses its own layout, its writer has to redo it to fit. Bina is in the same position.

skins.timing: You both write this week, separately.
skins.information: You both know what is at stake for each other. You don’t know Bina’s choice.
skins.matrixLabel: Outcomes for your layout and Bina’s layout

skins.title: The practice court
skins.situation: You and Sameer share a practice court. Each of you decides whether to book your slot online in advance or just turn up.

incentives.h.s.m3a: Booking ahead guarantees you a slot, and practice is best when you have both booked. If one of you just turns up while the other has booked, the one who turns up finds the court taken. Sameer is in the same position.

skins.timing: You both decide during the week, separately.
skins.information: You both know what is at stake for each other. You don’t know Sameer’s choice.
skins.matrixLabel: Outcomes for your booking and Sameer’s booking

skins.title: Two cultural evenings
skins.situation: The bigger residents’ group, led by Mr Varma, decides whether to hold its cultural evening on Saturday or Sunday. Your small group decides which day to hold its own.

incentives.h.s.m3c@B: Mr Varma’s group has the hall cheaply on Saturday, and gains when your evening is on Sunday. Your group does better on a different day from his; a clash on Saturday is worst for you.

skins.timing: Both groups announce at the same meeting.
skins.information: You know how Mr Varma’s group plans. You don’t know his day.
skins.matrixLabel: Outcomes for Mr Varma’s day and yours

skins.title: Saturday running routes
skins.situation: Your running club and Ms Rao’s club each pick a route for Saturday’s long run: the river loop or the hill loop. Both routes are narrow.

incentives.h.s.m3d: Each club runs better with a route to itself: you most want the river loop alone, Ms Rao’s club the hill loop. If you share, the river is less bad for you, the hill for her club.

skins.timing: Both clubs post their route on Friday, separately.
skins.information: You both know what the other wants. You don’t know which route Ms Rao will post.
skins.matrixLabel: Outcomes for your route and Ms Rao’s route

skins.title: Thali and drinks
skins.situation: You run a thali counter at a food court and Mr Kumar runs the drinks counter next to it. This month you choose which thali to promote, and he chooses which drink to promote.

incentives.h.s.m3e: What you each earn depends on how the two promotions fit together. Your best month is the special thali with lime water; Mr Kumar’s best is soda next to the plain thali, or buttermilk next to the mini thali.

skins.timing: You both fix your promotion on the first, separately.
skins.information: You both know the food court well. You don’t know Mr Kumar’s choice.
skins.matrixLabel: Outcomes for your thali and Mr Kumar’s drink

skins.title: Rows of tiles
skins.situation: A board holds nine tiles in three rows and three columns. At the same moment, you call out a row and the other side calls out a column; the tile where they cross is scored.

incentives.h.s.m3e: Points go to each side separately. You score highest on the third row, column one tile; the other side scores highest on two tiles: first row, column three, and second row, column two.

skins.timing: You both pick at the same moment.
skins.information: Each side sees the whole table. You don’t know the other side’s column.
skins.matrixLabel: Outcomes for your row and the other side’s column

skins.title: The evening delivery
skins.situation: You run a hardware shop. Your supplier, Mr Sood, decides whether to deliver tomorrow morning or in the evening. You decide whether to close at six as usual or stay open late.

incentives.h.s.m3f: Staying open late costs you nothing extra. An evening delivery can only be taken in if you are open; a morning one arrives while you are open anyway. Mr Sood prefers mornings, unless you stay open late.

skins.timing: You both decide today, separately.
skins.information: You know how Mr Sood plans. You don’t know when he will deliver.
skins.matrixLabel: Outcomes for your hours and Mr Sood’s delivery

skins.title: Weekend plans
skins.situation: You and Ved are planning this weekend. Ved decides whether to stay nearby or go out of town; at the same moment, you decide which of three plans to line up.

incentives.h.s.m2c@B: You do best lining up the quiet gathering when Ved stays nearby, and your best plan depends on what Ved decides. If Ved goes out of town, the games night and the film marathon suit you equally well.

skins.timing: Ved decides and you line up a plan at the same moment.
skins.information: You both know what the other wants. You don’t know whether Ved will stay nearby or go out of town.
skins.matrixLabel: Outcomes for Ved’s choice and your plan

skins.title: Workshop hours
skins.situation: You and Mr Dutta run the only two repair workshops in the market. Each month, you each set your opening hours: standard, shortened or extended.

incentives.h.s.m3g: Extended hours draw in customers who would otherwise go to Mr Dutta’s workshop, at some cost in staff overtime. Shortened hours save on staff and rent, more so when Mr Dutta also keeps his hours short.

skins.timing: You both set next month’s hours now, separately.
skins.information: You both know the market and each other’s costs. You don’t know which hours Mr Dutta will set.
skins.matrixLabel: Outcomes for your hours and Mr Dutta’s hours

skins.title: Morning or evening
skins.situation: You and Priya both busk on the same street corner. Each day, you each pick a slot: morning or evening.

incentives.h.s.m3h: The morning slot gets you more passers-by than the evening slot, and it pays especially well when Priya busks in the evening instead. Priya also draws a bigger crowd from the morning slot.

skins.timing: You both pick your slot at the start of the day, separately.
skins.information: You both know the street and what draws a crowd. You don’t know which slot Priya will pick.
skins.matrixLabel: Outcomes for your slot and Priya’s slot
